queue.title: Add --what-if mode to work-queue.js status
queue.description: (added ~s2113): The `status` subcommand shows current counts but doesn't simulate scenarios. A `--what-if close <id>` flag could show what queue health would look like after closing a specific item, useful for deciding whether to close or defer. Extends the dry-run pattern from wq-1054.
